520:t_1:88.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do you still like her?」

520:t_1:90.en:
$n
「But... it's a fact that $$マキ#pilot$$ helped me when I was in a bad place mentally.」

520:t_1:91.en:
$n
「Even if $$マキ#pilot$$ approached me on a $$クロノ$$ mission, I don't intend to forget that.」

520:t_1:92.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You're lucky, $n. Surrounded by $$マキ#pilot$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$.」

520:t_1:93.en:
$n
「I'm grateful to you too, $$ティティ$$.」

520:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Even if it's just flattery, being told that cheers me up.」

520:t_1:96.en:
$$クェス$$
「What's wrong, $$ハマーン$$? You look scary...」

520:t_1:98.en:
$$クェス$$
「Let's not do that. We're comrades fighting together, after all.」

520:t_1:100.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sorry. It's precisely because of that that there are things I can't say.」

520:t_1:101.en:
$$クェス$$
「Okay. ...But don't bottle everything up by yourself, all right?」

520:t_1:102.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems I made you worry about me. You have my thanks, $$クェス$$.」

520:t_1:103.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Oh... $$ハマーン$$... Have you seen $$マリーダ$$?」

520:t_1:104.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is in the infirmary. Exhaustion has piled up, and she's asleep.」

520:t_1:105.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is something... wrong with her?」

520:t_1:106.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It's not for me to say.」

520:t_1:107.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's all right, $$バナージ$$. $$ナナイ$$ is aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ too, so she'll examine $$マリーダ$$ for us.」

520:t_1:108.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I guess... There don't seem to be any combat operations for a while, so $$マリーダ$$ can get a good rest, too.」

520:t_1:109.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We'll be at the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ soon...」

520:t_1:110.en:
$$クェス$$
「Come to think of it, this is your first time going in there, $$ハマーン$$.」

520:t_1:112.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(What is this sense of foreboding...)

520:t_1:113.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(This unease... Is it connected to the chill I felt earlier...?)

520:t_2:3.en: ～ Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Dock ～

520:t_2:7.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't move, $c. You are completely surrounded.」

520:t_2:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「What's the meaning of this!? What is going on!」

520:t_2:9.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Still don't understand? This giant spaceship has already been seized by $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No way...! Are you saying that much jamming was broken through!?」

520:t_2:11.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What naive people. Repeating reckless actions without thinking ahead is what brought about this result.」

520:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You were the spy... I never imagined...」

520:t_2:17.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I have no intention of making excuses.」

520:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why, Captain!? $$マリーダ$$ is on $c too, you know! And yet...!」

520:t_2:19.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You are being unseemly, $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

520:t_2:23.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That shot earlier was a warning. Next time I will really fire.」

520:t_2:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believe I forbade rough tactics, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is a chance to meet face to face with all of you, with whom I share deep ties. I won't let it pass.」

520:t_2:31.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Of course, he is accompanying us. And naturally, he will sit in on our talks with you as well.」

520:t_2:32.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Talks...? Do you mean to show off your composure?」

520:t_2:33.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ハマーン$$... For my part, I do not wish to carelessly lose useful people, you included.」

520:t_2:34.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So I, too, will open my heart and reveal my true intent, in order to secure your cooperation.」

520:t_2:36.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So there's one here too who doesn't know how to speak properly.」

520:t_2:37.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Enough, $$アンジェロ$$. They must be on edge right now.」

520:t_2:38.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, rest from your long journey. The talks will be in six hours.」

520:t_2:39.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Understood. Until then, we will detain the members of $c.」

520:t_2:40.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Treat them with the utmost courtesy, mind you.」

520:t_2:42.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For now, we have no choice but to follow their instructions.」

520:t_2:43.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's fine. So you've finally understood your position.」

520:t_2:45.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't be impatient, $$ギュネイ$$. I'll give the traitor a fitting punishment later.」

520:t_2:46.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believe I forbade rough tactics, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is a chance to meet face to face with all of you, with whom I share deep ties. I won't let it pass.」

520:t_2:52.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Of course, he is accompanying us. And naturally, he will sit in on our talks with you as well.」

520:t_2:53.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Talks...? Do you mean to show off your composure?」

520:t_2:54.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ハマーン$$... For my part, I do not wish to carelessly lose useful people, you included.」
